header.description: Spray-dried instant coffee from green coffee beans: roasting with a catalytic afterburner, quench, cooling and grinding, extraction, clarification, vacuum evaporation and spray drying, with 16 thermal streams.

units.unit_description: This unit converts green coffee beans into 1 t/h of spray-dried instant coffee: roasting in batch drum roasters with gas recirculation and a catalytic afterburner, quench, cooling and grinding, extraction with water at 180 °C, cooling and clarification of the extract, single-effect vacuum evaporation, and spray drying with a fluid bed.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes green coffee beans, quench water, extraction water and electricity, and delivers instant coffee, silverskin, the roaster off-gas, flash steam, spent grounds, evaporator condensate and the water vapour of the dryer exhaust. The flows close at 10,151.3 kg/h in and out.

units.heat_streams_description: 8 cold and 8 hot streams, time-averaged over the operating hours; batch roasting and the extraction cycles are given by their average load. The roaster furnace (C1) and the afterburner (C2) are direct-fired duties, given as the heating of the process gas. Streams with a 1 K span are phase changes.
